articles.summary: New structure extends the growth strategy to sharpen execution and accelerate growth across its two core platforms Calgary, Alberta–(Newsfile Corp. – November 16, 2026) – Obsidian Energy Ltd. (“Obsidian Energy” or the “Company”) today announced it will move from our current functional model to two dedicated asset teams, Heavy Oil and Light Oil, effective December 1, 2026. This organizational structure supports the Company’s growth across both platforms, building on our continued investment in Peace River heavy oil waterflood development and the acquisition of Belly River light oil assets in Wilson Creek.
